messages:
olivia_csm: Heads-up — ArkBridge usage dropped ~48% over the last 14 days. Billing unchanged. New PM started last Tue. Putting renewal (Q4) on watch. Can we triage?
priya_cs_ops: Thanks for flagging. Do we have a spike in errors or auth failures? or just fewer calls?
olivia_csm: No errors, requests per minute down. Signals-bot alerted at 09:12. Last prod eval run was 3 weeks ago.
signals-bot: automated-alert: usage_drop=48% window=14d severity=medium victims=arkbridge-prod-token-12 
gabe_ae: Hey team — I'm their AE. I spoke with their CFO last week; procurement still good but PM mentioned "re-prioritizing roadmap." Might be evaluating vendor X and Y.
marta_support: There's an open legal Q about data retention + hashed-pii that we pinged legal on 03/10. Ticket #CS-8421 still waiting. That could block their internal pilot expansion.
alex_se: I can run a 30m cost/throughput + integration health check for the new PM. Suggest: 15m walkthrough + 15m Q&A. Availability Tues/Wed.
priya_cs_ops: Good. Action items: 1) Gabe — intro to new PM & confirm evaluation vendors 2) Olivia — send usage snapshot & top-10 inactive routes 3) Alex — enablement slot + PR checklist to unblock pilot 4) Marta — escalate legal Q in ticket.
gabe_ae: Will do intros. Quick template I can send to PM:
```
Hi <PM name>,
Congrats on the new role. We'd love to help get ArkBridge's pilot back on track. Can we do a 30-min technical + cost runthrough next week? Also curious who else you're evaluating and any must-have privacy constraints.
— Gabe
```
olivia_csm: Sharing brief usage snapshot (top routes trimmed):
```
- /api/v1/generate   last14d: 220 calls (was 1400)
- /api/v1/embeddings last14d: 90 calls (was 270)
- avg latency  p95: 210ms (stable)
- errors: <0.1% (stable)
```
marta_support: Noted. I'll tag legal again and add PM email to the ticket. If retention policy is the blocker we can propose a short-term enclave + logs-redaction pattern.
alex_se: Prep checklist for the session: sample prompt tuning, batching config (to reduce cost), and fallback model variants for availability. I'll also prepare a one-pager comparing cost/latency for their typical seq lengths.
priya_cs_ops: Timeline: escalate legal today, Gabe intro by EOD tomorrow, enablement by next Wed ideally. I'll mark renewal as "watch" in CRM and set a follow-up reminder.
olivia_csm: Also request competitive intel: Gabe, can you ask PM whether they're doing a POC or just vendor discovery? if POC, we should ask for acceptance criteria.
gabe_ae: On it. I'll loop in PM and ask a few targeted Qs.
olivia_csm: Thanks. If anyone sees further drop or billing changes ping this thread. :thumbsup:
priya_cs_ops: Closing with owners: Gabe (AE) owner for PM intro & competitive intel, Olivia (CSM) owner for usage/context, Alex (SE) owner for enablement, Marta (Support) owner for legal escalation. We'll reconvene after PM intro.
